article_content: Gwamnan Jigawa ya ce akwai maganar inganta ainihin noma a Auyo, amma ba'a cigaba ba. An yi alkawarin za'a sa kudi kamar nera miliyan dubu goma zuwa ashirin wanda har yanzu ba'a cika ba. Abu na biyu an ce za'a yi filin jirgin sama na dauka da saukar da kaya wato 'Cargo Airport' a turance. Guda shida aka ce za'a yi a Najeriya cikinsu aka ce za'a yi daya a Dutse. Dalili ke nan yace sh zai fara nasa daga baya a biyashi. Na uku hanya da ta taso daga Gaya zuwa Jahun zuwa Kafin Hausa hanyar tafi shekara ashirin bata da kayau. Gwamnan yace ya gayawa shugaban kasa da mataimakinsa. Akwai maganar fadada ruwan Dutse domin nan da shekara hamsin Dutse zai kasance cikin manya manyan biranen Afirka. Yace an yi masa alkawarin basa gudummawa. Akwai kuma matsalar kwararowar hamada. Yace duk wadannan abubuwa aka yi ma su mutanen Jigawa alkawari. Yakamata a gane babu wani da suka hana takara. Duk Najeriya kowa nada 'yanci yayi takara. Amma maganar ita ce sun sa adashi a a dubu biyu da sha daya. Adashin suke so a biyasu. Idan aka biyasu adashin to 2015 kafin su sake zubawa zasu so su sani menene za'a yi masu.
translated_content: The Governor of Jigawa State stated that there are plans to improve agriculture in Auyo, but unfortunately, no progress has been made. A commitment was made to allocate millions of dollars, but this has yet to be fulfilled. Additionally, a cargo airport is slated for construction in Dutse. In total, six airports are planned for Nigeria, with one of them being in Dutse. The rationale behind this is that operations are expected to commence shortly. The road connecting Gaya, Jahun, and Kafin Hausa has been neglected for twenty years. The Governor claims to have informed the President and the Vice President about this matter. There are also plans to expand the water supply in Dutse, as the city is projected to become one of the largest in Africa within the next fifty years. The Governor mentioned that contributions were pledged. Furthermore, the issue of desert encroachment is a concern. According to the Governor, all these promises were made to the people of Jigawa. It is essential to recognize that no one has been barred from participating in the political process. Every Nigerian has the right to participate. However, the problem lies in the fact that they have been deceived since 2011 and are seeking deception once more. If they are deceived again, it will be reminiscent of 2015 before they realize what is happening to them.

article_content: An kafa sashen Hausa na Muryar Amurka ran 21 ga watan Junairu, shekara ta 1979, domin watsa labaran duniya da shirye-shirye zuwa ga Hausawa da masu jin harshen Hausa a duk fadin duniya, musamman ma yammacin Afirka kamar kasashen Nigeria, Ghana, Nijar, Chadi, Libya, Cote d’Ivoire da wasu sassan janhuriyar Benin. Sashen Hausa na watsa sa'oi 15.5 na shirye-shirye a kowace mako, ta radiyo da yanar intanet. Sashen kuma na buga labaran gida Najeria, da sauran duniya, da bidiyon manyan labaran Afirka daga ran Litinin zuwa Juma’a akan shafinsa na intanet. Shirye-shiryen sashen sun hada da labarai masu zafi , da rahotannin wakilai daga duk fadin duniya, tattaunawa da manyan jami’an gwamnatoci, ganawa da masu fashin baki, fadakarwa daga malamai da manazarta, dauka da watsa ra’ayoyin masu sauraro da suke bayarwa a rubuce, ta waya kai tsaye da kuma ta email.
translated_content: The Hausa service of Voice of America was established on June 21, 1979, to broadcast world news and programs to Hausa speakers and those who understand the Hausa language around the world, especially in West Africa, such as Nigeria, Ghana, Niger, Chad, Libya, Cote d'Ivoire, and parts of the Republic of Benin. The Hausa service broadcasts 15.5 hours of programming per week, via radio and internet. The service also publishes local news from Nigeria and around the world, as well as videos of major African news from Monday to Friday on its website. The service's programs include hot news, reports from correspondents around the world, interviews with senior government officials, discussions with activists, insights from scholars and experts, and broadcasting of listeners' opinions sent in writing, by mail, and by email.

article_content: Nan moman presyon ap ogmante sou Prezidan René Préval pou li remèt pouvwa a pou fasilite òganizasyon eleksyon kredib nan peyi Dayiti, yon sektè enpòtan nan vi nasyonal la deklare li pa dakò ak demach opozisyon an, men prezidan an vle respekte règ Konstitisyon an ak dat li fikse pou manda l' fini, swa an fevriye 2011. Prezidan Chanm Komès ak Endistri Ayisyen an, Réginald Boulos, deklare 'fòse prezidan an kite pouvwa a kounye a, se yon aksyon ki ka lage peyi a nan plis enstabilite'. Misye Boulos di 'mete nou nan plas donatè entènasyonal yo la ki, gen apèn yon mwa edmi, fenk sòt pran angajman pou debloke 10 milya dola pou ede rebati Ayiti apre tranblemann'tè 12 janvye a e ki wè peyi a tonbe nan yon politik dechoukaj...'. Prezidan Chanm Komès ak Endistri a la envite gouvènman an ak KEP a pran mezi pou l' travay vit-e-prese pou eleksyon dewoule ann Ayiti nan mwa novanm ane sa a e pou prezidan Préval fè yon chita-tande ak tout sektè peyi a pou diskite sou òganizasyon eleksyon yo e sou chanjman ki ta merite fèt nan konstitisyon peyi a. Antretan, prezidan Konsèy Elektoral la, Gaillot Dorsinvil, anonse mèkredi li pral oganize eleksyon jeneral nan peyi a dènye dimanch mwad novanm nan 2010 la, men prezidan Préval vle asire w ke eleksyon yo pral fèt nan yon kad legal ak konstitisyonnel.
translated_content: As pressure mounts on President René Préval to step down to facilitate the organization of credible elections in Haiti, a key sector of national life has expressed disagreement with the opposition's approach, while emphasizing the importance of respecting the Constitution and the scheduled end of the president's term in February 2011. The President of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Haiti, Réginald Boulos, warned that 'forcing the president to leave power now would be an action that could lead to greater instability in the country'. Mr. Boulos noted that 'international donors, who have recently committed to providing $10 million to support Haiti's reconstruction efforts following the January 12 earthquake, are concerned about the country's descent into chaos...'. The President of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry has urged the government and the Electoral Council to take urgent measures to ensure that the elections take place in Haiti in November this year, and for President Préval to engage in dialogue with all sectors of the country to discuss the organization of the elections and potential constitutional reforms. Meanwhile, the President of the Electoral Council, Gaillot Dorsinvil, has announced plans to hold general elections in the country on the last Sunday of November 2010, with President Préval seeking to ensure that the elections are conducted within a legal and constitutional framework.

article_content: An kafa sashen Hausa na Muryar Amurka ran 21 ga watan Junairu, shekara ta 1979, domin watsa labaran duniya da shirye-shirye zuwa ga Hausawa da masu jin harshen Hausa a duk fadin duniya, musamman ma yammacin Afirka kamar kasashen Nigeria, Ghana, Nijar, Chadi, Libya, Cote d’Ivoire da wasu sassan janhuriyar Benin. Sashen Hausa na watsa sa’oi 20 na shirye-shirye a kowace mako, ta radiyo da yanar intanet. Sashen kuma na buga labaran gida Najeria, da sauran duniya, da bidiyon manyan labaran Afirka daga ran Litinin zuwa Juma’a akan shafinsa na intanet. Shirye-shiryen sashen sun hada da labarai masu zafi , da rahotannin wakilai daga duk fadin duniya, tattaunawa da manyan jami’an gwamnatoci, ganawa da masu fashin baki, fadakarwa daga malamai da manazarta, dauka da watsa ra’ayoyin masu sauraro da suke bayarwa a rubuce, ta waya kai tsaye da kuma ta email. Kuma akwai sabon shiri mai suna 'Labarai na Yau' wanda ke watsa labarai na yau daga ko'ina cikin duniya, wanda zai jawo masa masu sauraro damar su san abin da ke faruwa a duniya.
translated_content: The Hausa service of Voice of America was launched on January 21, 1979, to broadcast global news and programs to Hausa speakers and Hausa language enthusiasts worldwide, particularly in West Africa, including countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Niger, Chad, Libya, Cote d'Ivoire, and parts of Benin. The Hausa service airs 20 hours of programming weekly, via radio and the internet. It also publishes Nigerian and international news, as well as major African news videos, from Monday to Friday on its website. The service's programs feature in-depth news, reports from global correspondents, interviews with high-ranking government officials, discussions with activists, expert analysis, and broadcasts of listener feedback received via mail, email, and online. Additionally, there's a new program called 'Today's News' that brings listeners up-to-date news from around the globe, keeping them informed about current events.

article_content: Abin da ya faru ya tuna min da watan Aprilu 2011, inda wancan lokacin sa'o'i gabanin fara zabe hukumar INEC ta dage zaben da kwananki biyu. Dalilin da aka bayar wancan shekarar ma dai kamar a bana hujja daya aka bayar na cewar kayayyakin zabe ba su kai ga isa a duk sassan kasar ba. A lokacin kowa ya rude, sai dai daga karshe an yaba wa shugaban hukumar Attahiru Jega da cewar matakin da ya dauka na dage zaben ya yi ma'ana. Haka zalika a shekara ta 2015 Jega ya sake dage lokacin gudanar da zaben. Bayan da jami'an tsaro suka bashi shawarar cewa bisa rikicin boko haram da ya yi kamari ba za su ba da tabbacin yin zabe cikin lumana ba. Don haka INEC ta dage zaben da makwanni shida. a wancan lokacin a yi ta guna-gunin, amma a karshe aka gudanar da zabe na tarihi inda karon farko a tarihin Najeriya jam'iyyar adawa ta kada gwamnati mai ci, abin da ya dora Shugaba Muhammadu Buhari kan mulki. Shin ko 'yan Najeriya na iya gamsuwa da wannan matakin dage zabe cikin dare daya. Daya dai sun kasa hakura, domin a shafukan sada zumunta an yi rabuta kana ko kan tituna mutum zai ji jama'a na cewa Allah wadai. Hukumomi na mai da kasarmu abun dariya. Sai kuma batun jita-jita da yarfe tsakanin masu mulki da 'yan adawa, yayin da 'yan adawa ke cewa jam'iyyar APC ce ta shirya makudin zabe, su kuwa masu mulki na cewa ai PDP ce ta saye hukumar zabe don a yi mata yadda take so. A matsayin dan kallo mutum sai ya rasa me zai ce kan wannan lamarin domin har yammacin Juma'a hukumar zabe na cewa sun shirya tsab don samar wa Najeriya sahihin zabe. Tun makwanni akwai alamar shirin hukumar zabe na tafiyar hawainiya, don haka ba wani babban mamaki ba ne da jin labarin dage zaben. To shin wa zai yi asara a wannan dage zaben, a tsari irin na Najeriya, komai abu ne da ka iya faruwa domin suna da wata siyasa mai matukar sarkakiya. A zahiri dai wata kila a cewa babbar jam'iyyar adawa ta PDP ita ce ke da asara domin ta fidda kudi na biyan wakilanta da za su kula da zabe a fadin kasar, yayin da a bangarenta APC mai mulki wannan asarar tana da sauki kasancewa suna kan mulk domin dama jihohi da suke mulki za su ba da kudin aiki. Yayin da wasu 'yan Najeriya suna dora laifi kan shugaban hukumar zabe Mahmood Yakubu da wannan rudu, amma wasu na ganin mutumin dake da babban laifi shi ne shugaba Muhammadu Buhari. Koma me ka iya biyo baya, a Najeriya a kan shiga irin wannan rudu amma daga karshe sai ka ga komai ya tafi salun alun.
translated_content: What happened recently in April 2011, when the INEC commission postponed the election by two weeks. The reason given at that time was that the election materials were not sufficient to cover all parts of the country. At that time, everyone was upset, but in the end, the chairman of the commission, Attahiru Jega, was commended for taking the decision to postpone the election. Similarly, in 2015, Jega again postponed the election after security officials advised him that due to the Boko Haram insurgency, they could not guarantee a safe election. Therefore, INEC postponed the election by six weeks. At that time, there was a lot of outcry, but in the end, a historic election was held in which the opposition party won for the first time in Nigerian history, and President Muhammadu Buhari came to power. Can Nigerians tolerate this kind of election postponement overnight? Some people are already frustrated, and on social media, people are saying that God is not pleased with the government. The government is making our country a laughing stock. There is also a rumor circulating between the ruling party and the opposition, with the opposition claiming that the APC planned the election postponement, while the ruling party claims that the PDP bribed the electoral commission to do their bidding. As an observer, one is unsure about what to say about this situation, because every Friday, the electoral commission says they are ready to conduct a free and fair election. For weeks now, there have been indications that the commission is serious about conducting the election, so it's no surprise to hear about the postponement. So, who will be affected by this election postponement? In a country like Nigeria, anything can happen due to the high level of politics involved. In reality, some people are saying that the main opposition party, PDP, will be affected because they have spent a lot of money on their agents who will monitor the election across the country, while the ruling party, APC, will not be severely affected because they are in power and the states they control will provide them with the necessary funds. While some Nigerians are blaming the chairman of the electoral commission, Mahmood Yakubu, for the postponement, others believe that President Muhammadu Buhari is the one who should be held accountable. What can one say about this situation? In Nigeria, we can experience this kind of thing, but in the end, everything will work out.
